title: Cap. III Sol. Rat. 4 close: gratuitous election stands; crown as prize; foresight after
pass_a_gloss: and finally let us answer this, That men can be elected gratuitously to eternal life, although the crown of eternal life is decreed to be set upon the elect as a prize of a life laudably and justly spent. For the will of God concerning the mode of bringing them to the prize through works of holiness does not overturn the gratuitous and merciful election to eternal life from the primary purpose and mere good pleasure of the one electing. For when God decrees to bring someone to glory through such works, the primary decree of giving glory does not arise from foresight of those works, but from this decree flows the will of giving efficacious grace for doing such works of justice. Their foresight, therefore, is posterior to election.
pass_b_english: and finally: people can be elected gratuitously to eternal life even when the crown of eternal life is decreed to be set on the elect as the prize of a life lived laudably and justly. God’s will about the way of bringing them to that prize through holy works does not overturn gratuitous, merciful election to eternal life from the elector’s primary purpose and mere good pleasure. When God decrees to bring someone to glory through such works, the primary decree to give glory does not rise from foresight of those works — rather, from that decree flows the will to give efficacious grace for doing such works of justice. So foresight of them is after election.
source_text: et illud denique respondeamus, Eligi posse homines gratuito ad vitam aeternam, quamvis corona vitae aeternae decernatur electis imponenda, ut premium vitae laudabiliter justeque transactae. Nam voluntas Dei de modo perducendi ad premium per opera sanctitatis, non evertit gratuitam et misericordem electionem ad vitam aeternam ex proposito primario et beneplacito mero eligentis. Quando enim Deus decernit perducere aliquem ad gloriam per talia opera, primarium decretum dandi gloriam non oritur ex praevisione illorum operum, sed ex hoc decreto fluit voluntas dandi gratiam efficacem ad talia opera justitiae facienda. Illorum igitur praevisio electione posterior.
